visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male creator with dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt, holds an orange smartphone in his right hand. He smiles widely, showing his teeth, and looks directly at the camera in a selfie perspective against an orange-lit textured background. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the back of the orange phone, showing three camera lenses arranged in a triangle on a raised module. A hand rotates the device to catch the light, highlighting a satin-finish orange back panel. (3) The creator stands in a bright, modern indoor space with white walls and a large glass window. He holds up three different phones (light green, lavender, and orange) and moves his head back and forth excitedly while speaking. (4) Close-up shot of the phone screen interface where the creator demonstrates a 'dual-recording' camera feature, showing a small window of his face overlaying a larger shot of a suitcase in a room. (5) The creator demonstrates a camera filter mode on the screen, swiping through options that change the color temperature and skin tone of his own image displayed on the phone. (6) A final montage shows the creator holding multiple devices and posing as the screen displays a film-strip border effect with camera shutter flash graphics.
